title: Teddeendi jawdi
intro: Aɗa darii e yeeso daartol dañal mawngal, nguurndam mbelɗam e kaŋŋe e doole, kono haa jooni ko jannde jeertinaande wonande kala yiɗɓe mawngu aduna. Mbele aɗa waawi ƴeewtaade sifaa ooɗoo limre nde daartol mum ina ɓuuɓtoo e nder jamaanu, seedantaagal sifaa jawdi aduna ndi ɓooyaani ?
clues: Mi jeyaa ko e leñol Annabi mawɗo, kono mi suɓii ko laawol mawnikinaare e tooñannge.
Alla rokkii kam jawdi keewndi, haa coktirgal ngalu am wonti teddungal teeŋtungal wonande fedde worɓe tiiɗɓe.
Yimɓe am wasiyiima mi hoto mi welto e jawdi am, ina ciftina kam wonde Alla yiɗaa weltotooɗo.
Miɗo wiya e mawnikinaare wonde jawdi am mawndi ndii ko e ganndal am e tiiɗnaare am, wonaa barke ummoraade e Alla.
Mi jeertinaama e fenaande mi siftinaama yoo mi ɗaɓɓu laakara e ko Alla rokki mi, kono mi caliima heɗaade mi jokki e mawnikinaare am.
Haa jooni, Alla waɗi leydi ndii muñde mi e hoɗorde am, mi acci mi alaa balloowo e dow yamiroore makko.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
